lines.native: I'm Gerald. This market? One espresso shot out of five. Un caffè, senza latte? Milk is a war crime.
lines.translation: I'm Gerald. This market? One espresso shot out of five. A coffee, without milk? Milk is a war crime.
lines.narrative: At The Coffee Cart in The Crumbling Market, an imp polishes a cup while the surrounding masonry quietly gives up.

lines.native: Un caffè? Bene. Your polite order earns three espresso shots out of five. But you haven't specified no milk. Add «senza latte, per favore» to your order. I refuse to supervise a dairy incident.
lines.translation: A coffee? Good. Your polite order earns three espresso shots out of five. But you haven't specified no milk. Add “without milk, please” to your order. I refuse to supervise a dairy incident.
lines.narrative: Gerald hovers over the milk jug as though guarding a crime scene.

lines.native: Senza latte, per favore. Perfetto! Un caffè senza latte. Your order is complete. Four espresso shots out of five; the fifth requires better company.
lines.translation: Without milk, please. Perfect! A coffee without milk. Your order is complete. Four espresso shots out of five; the fifth requires better company.
lines.narrative: Gerald slides over a tiny cup, looking relieved that international dairy law remains untested.
